personal.tagline: Building the future with AI agents, intelligent orchestration systems, and reactive data platforms
personal.bio: I am an Associate Architect at EY with 10 years of experience in software architecture and data engineering. I have a strong passion for AI technologies and agentic orchestration, working on multiple personal applications using cutting-edge technologies including Camunda 8.8 for agentic orchestration, Azure OpenAI, AutoGen, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). I'm currently developing an enterprise-level agentic orchestration tool using Spring AI and MCP as a personal project. My expertise spans from designing microservices architectures to implementing reactive data platforms and exploring multi-agent systems for intelligent automation.

experience.description: Working as an Associate Architect focusing on architectural design and implementation of microservices and event-driven systems. Actively exploring AI technologies including Camunda 8.8 agentic orchestration, Azure OpenAI, AutoGen, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) through personal projects and proof-of-concepts.
Led technical teams in designing and implementing resilient data engineering systems. Focused on building solutions that unlock insights and streamline operations.
Managed technical delivery of complex projects involving microservices architecture and data engineering solutions.
Developed scalable technology solutions and contributed to enterprise-level software development projects in Bengaluru.
Started career in software development, gained foundational experience in programming and system design.
